_comment: Golden wire fixture for custom hosts, the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (docs/design/V3_CUSTOM_HOSTS.md). Copy this file byte for byte. The Worker's validators (ci/vast-broker/src/hosts.js validateDaemonFrame / validateServerFrame) accept every `valid` frame and refuse every `invalid` one; ci/vast-broker/test/hosts-wire.test.js checks ALL of them. Frames use `type`; `v` is optional and must be 1.

constants.ack_semantics: ack = offer accepted (profile checks passed, before the fetch); ready = commit fetched and verified; nack = refused or, after an ack, failed (the run is released, the requirement stays unmet, nothing is recorded as a result)

invalid.why: commands_until_ms is a number or null
repo must be the canonical URL
run section (nonce, runner_nonce, sha) is required
seed url must be a public IPv4
fallback host must be an IP-encoding mapper name of the same ip
requirements are never sent to a daemon (the Worker plans, the daemon runs the listed steps)
stages is gone: steps is the one mechanism
apps must be an array of strings

run_report_fields._comment: Keys of the EXISTING run report (POST /run-report/<run>-<attempt>), never of the result (POST /report, exact key set).
